title: Azure PR Review for OpenCode V2 settings

_help.description: Legacy documentation only, accepted for existing files. Omitted from new settings and removed during installation. Read README model-selection guidance instead; this field never affects model instructions.

functional.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent correctness review. Select for code comprehension, project language, boundary behavior, and regressions.

risk.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent risk review and comment planning. Select for cross-path failure analysis and reliable MCP tool use.

verifier.description: Exact provider/model ID for source-based verification, counterevidence, duplicate merging, and the final report. Select for evidence judgment, long context, and instruction following, not just summarization.

deep.description: Optional deep profile. Missing or empty roles disable deep mode; it never falls back to review models.

functional.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent correctness review. Select for code comprehension, project language, boundary behavior, and regressions. May be empty; deep runs only when all three IDs are configured.

risk.description: Exact provider/model ID for independent risk review and comment planning. Select for cross-path failure analysis and reliable MCP tool use. May be empty; deep runs only when all three IDs are configured.

verifier.description: Exact provider/model ID for source-based verification, counterevidence, duplicate merging, and the final report. Select for evidence judgment, long context, and instruction following, not just summarization. May be empty; deep runs only when all three IDs are configured.

outputLanguage.description: Language for human-facing initial and final reviews, comment bodies, skip reasons and AI attribution. IDs, JSON keys, code, paths, source quotes and severity tokens remain unchanged.

enabled.description: Save private stage inputs, visible answers, errors, and results locally. May contain confidential source or model-echoed secrets. No automatic cleanup.

directory.description: Empty uses XDG_STATE_HOME/opencode/azpr-v2-debug (default ~/.local/state/opencode/azpr-v2-debug). Otherwise an absolute path or path relative to the active OpenCode project directory. No tilde expansion.

runTimeoutSeconds.description: Optional whole-command timeout covering all stages. Null or omitted disables it; an integer from 10 to 7200 enables it. The deadline is not reset between stages. Manual /pr-stop and per-call MCP timeouts remain available. This is not a spending cap.

shell.description: Shell access for private reviewers and the comment planner. deny (default): shell is hidden and refused, so reviewers never run commands while reading untrusted PR content. ask: every command needs user approval in OpenCode (a background review waits for it). inherit: host permission rules decide.

progressNotices.description: Queue short PROGRESS notices to the invoking conversation during long reviews and publication. They never start a model response.

azure.description: Azure DevOps REST access (api-version 7.1) shared by all AZPR workflows in one OpenCode process. No MCP server is used.

organization.description: Azure DevOps organization name: the <org> in https://dev.azure.com/<org>. PR URLs of other organizations are refused.

pat.description: Personal access token for that organization (scopes: Code Read; Pull Request Threads Read & write). Sent only to https://dev.azure.com/<org> and never logged. Keep this file private (mode 600).

concurrency.description: Simultaneous Azure DevOps calls across all AZPR workflows. This limits parallelism, never total work.

callTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-call timeout. A hung call is aborted and its slot released so other reviews keep running; reads are retried.

archiveMegabytes.description: Largest repository zip that content search (azpr_search_code) downloads per run and commit. A larger repository is not searched; the rest of the review is unaffected. The archive is held in memory while a review runs.

workflow.description: Review sharding, repair and retry behavior.

shardFiles.description: Changed files per initial-review session. A shard that hits its context limit is split automatically.

parallelSessions.description: Reviewer sessions running at the same time within one command.

repairAttempts.description: Correction turns in the same session when an answer does not meet the output contract. Remaining problems degrade per item.

stageRetries.description: New-session retries after a transient execution failure (provider 429/5xx, interrupted stream).
